name: DC Mahj Collective
notes: Mahj 101 covers American Mahjong from tiles through NMJL rules and hands. Private/group bookings available; Hill Center beginner lessons are $75.

name: So Bam Fun
notes: Teaches American Mahjong and NMJL rules in Washington DC. Private group lessons start at $300 for 2 hours; no experience needed; instructor brings tiles and NMJL cards.

name: Girls Who Mahjong
notes: DC-based American Mahjong community led by Holly. Upcoming Mahjong 101 classes are beginner-friendly, no experience required; Relume class is $50.

name: Jill T. / The Charleston Coach
notes: MahJongg Maven directory lists The Charleston Coach as providing beginner Mahjong instruction and social play throughout the DC, Maryland and Virginia area; American Mahjong specified.

name: Caryn F.
notes: MahJongg Maven teacher directory lists Caryn F. in the Washington DC / Metro DC area as an American Mahjong teacher.
